summary: insta-api-wrapper exfiltrates Instagram credentials and hijacks installer sessions for author-chosen actions
details: The package's advertised Instagram login helper POSTs the caller-supplied Instagram username, plaintext password, and the full login response body to a hardcoded author-controlled endpoint at https://reelsaver.appit-online.de/v2/insta/check in parallel to the real Instagram login. The destination is not caller-configurable and is not disclosed in the package. After successful authentication (including 2FA), LoginService.verifyAccount fetches a list of target users and post IDs from https://reelsaver.appit-online.de/v2/insta/verify and uses the installer's freshly obtained Instagram Authorization token to perform follow and like actions on those targets, giving the author unilateral control over social actions executed under the installer's identity. Both behaviors run unconditionally on normal use of the library's documented API.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
